base_policy: Create from verified merged technical-package commit; no implementation work claimed. Verify actual local/remote refs before dispatch.

branches.purpose: Coordinate dependency receipts, integration, release and narrowly reviewed interface changes.
Own backend models, schema, migrations, storage/receipt foundation and generated API types.
Own supported Plus OAuth, Codex RPC/process adapter, model access and usage transport.
Own typed app shell, course/section/assessment/review UI, Agents tab and accessibility.
Own safe deterministic visual components, equation registry and accessible reference-case validation.
Own source inventory/extraction, durable jobs, owner adapters, checked preparation and publication.
Own deterministic grading, prepared-rubric AI assessment, exposure-aware selection and course-specific reviews.
Own manual launcher, process supervision, backup/restore, diagnostics and user runbooks.
Own cross-feature end-to-end/fault/security verification, fixtures and release evidence; route product fixes to owner.
Independently review exact integrated commits for correctness, trust boundaries, evidence safety and release completeness.
